profile.headline: Senior Web Developer
profile.summary: Specialties: wordpress, woocommerce, magento, computer hardware, database administration, hardware support, help desk support, javascript, jQuery, mysql, network administration, network engineering, php, programming,  troubleshooting, xml

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Using PHP, I come up with solutions, whether it be a WordPress plugin or a whole custom system. I integrate PHP and MySQL, sometimes with a little bit of AJAX and make things fit into whatever constraints I have.

positions.title: Web Developer and Applications Programmer
positions.description:
PHP development for advanced web-marketing sites
Built desktop applications using VB.NET for internal usage and testing

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Integration of dynamic interface using PHP, .NET, ASP, CSS
Database connectivity using MySQL, MS SQL, MS Access, XML
Consistently meets/exceeds deadlines and performance based bonus qualifiers

positions.title: Technology Specialist / Network Administrator
positions.description:
Maintained company all hardware and software in Active Directory domain with Citrix environment
Responsible for SQL server, VPN, Win NT,2000, 2003, IIS, DNS, Routers, Switches, Network Architecture
Maintained, Administered SQL DB's including architecture, security and maintenance design, performance optimization, data queries and reports (Crystal Reports); system documentation
Provide support, training and education on software/hardware to employees; inventory control
Travel to company trade shows to support registration desk and public computer lab systems.

positions.title: Computer Analyst / Technician
positions.description:
Website Design, Maintenance, Hosting including DNS/IIS
Database Administration of SQL/VB programs, Crystal Reports
Maintain company and client computers - hardware and software in networked environments
Provide training and education on software to customers

positions.title: Forms Programmer and ACS Support Technician
positions.description:
Built, upgraded and customized report forms for car dealership software including ACS and CAT using Crystal Reports
Supported 750+ Dealerships: Troubleshooting, Support and Technical Assistance via PC Anywhere and Phone

positions.title: Computer Technician & Programmer/ Internet Developer
positions.description:
Built and configured Microsoft NT Web Server for in house and client hosting including ASP Support
Provided HTTP and FTP access
Created and maintained in house and client e-mail services using Red Hat Linux
Configured and maintained hardware and software for 150+ clients including traveling to offices
Educated clients in use of hardware, software and internet applications
Customized Goldmine reports for client use; created and maintained multiple Access databases

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description:
Supported all in house systems - hardware and software 
Developed Access Database programs for in house use in help desk and inventory

positions.title: Webmaster & Technical Support
positions.description:
Designed and maintained web page for Real Estate Brokerage 
Supported all in house systems
